ValidationRule.description: This rule requires the Loan Purpose to be populated if the Lead Source is either Realtor Referral, Past Client, Personal Referral, Previous Client Referral, or Biz Dev Outlaw.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Loan_Purpose__c ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status , 'New')), OR( ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Realtor Referral"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Past Client"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Personal Referral"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Previous Client Referral"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Reach In Market Dialer"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Biz Dev - Outlaw"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Biz Dev - Saludes"), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Biz Dev - Carey")))
